name: @gofastr/calendar-frame-bundle
description: In-frame calendar bundle for the GoFastr calendar plugin. Hand-written month/week/day views, no calendar library: builds a single dependency-free IIFE that runs inside the opaque-origin sandboxed iframe and speaks protocol v1 to the host over postMessage. The frame renders server-resolved occurrences only — RRULE expansion, timezone conversion and conflict detection all run in Go — and sends move INTENTS (wall-clock deltas) that the host re-resolves.
